title: Slime Boost Boots
description:
This plugin for Minecraft Java Servers, adds a new type of boots: Slime Boost.
These boots obtainable through this command below:
/gsb @s <leather:chainmail:gold:iron:copper:diamond:netherite>
You can press the your jump twice to get thrown foward.
